checks.name: Live local API loaded six seeded cases with honest mode labels
Responsive layouts at 320, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440px without document overflow
Case search and recoverable empty state
Printed label is distinct from physical dispatch; evidence and keyboard-accessible draft tabs
Read-only role removes mutation authority and explains the role
Pre-label cancellation approved, executed and verified through UI
Lost warehouse response stays unconfirmed until the same operation is reconciled
Post-label cancellation requires hold, approval, void and final verification
Address correction with one replacement label completes through UI
Lost refund response reconciles to one refund through UI
Carrier void rejection remains visibly escalated
Partially dispatched case stays under operator review
New request, ambiguity clarification, fault injection, partial failure and safe retry
Customer explanation remains a local draft; no console/page/network errors
Visible text meets measured contrast thresholds in recovery, evidence, draft and failure views
checks.scope: Computed solid-background text; not a complete accessibility certification.

presentation_checks.name: Loading states announce progress and finish before enabling the evidence view
Roving tabs, Home/End, arrow navigation and search shortcut retain keyboard focus
Invalid and whitespace-only forms make no API write; server errors preserve input and Escape restores focus
Service failure explains unavailable evidence and disables stale actions; reconnect recovers
Offline startup and genuinely empty queue have recoverable, honest states
Empty order catalog offers an explanation instead of an unusable form
Configured intake mode and actual result provenance remain distinct, including mobile and recorded fixtures
Untrusted request markup is literal text and triggers no script or mutation

presentation_disclosure: Presentation-only controlled responses. No real model inference, provider behavior or backend recovery is inferred from these checks.
